attack.note: Hatred stacks up to 10, each adding 8 percent attack damage and move speed. Almost all sustained value is stutter stepped basic attacks; Farflight Quiver and Manticore make that stronger.

poke.note: Basic attacks are reliable and have good range, Multishot is a wide area ability with long range, and Hungering Arrow homes. Poke is consistent but needs a clear line.

damage.note: A strong single target sustained carry with on demand area burst from Multishot and Strafe. Hatred and Manticore percent health bonus make her good at breaking large health pools, and Hungering Arrow plus Vault is a burst option. She is stopped by blinds and crowd control, not by healing.

good_into.why: Hatred ramped basic attacks, Manticore percent health and Strafe damage outpace healing, and the guide says she is very strong against healer heavy metas.
Manticore deals 4 percent of max health and Hatred scales with sustained hits, so she melts tanks in long fights.
Frost Shot slows from Multishot, Hot Pursuit move speed and Vault let her kite melee heroes, and Rain of Vengeance stuns.
Siphoning Arrows and Tempered by Discipline give sustain and she outranges many heroes with Farflight Quiver.
Hungering Arrow, Multishot and Vault combos can kill a low health target with Repeating Arrow or Acrobat.

bad_into.why: She has little self peel, low health, and gap closers such as Zeratul pass Vault range; the guide names this explicitly.
Stuns, polymorph and blinds nullify Strafe and stop Hatred stacking, and she has no cleanse.
Her health is low and Gloom or a Vault is the only defense against a coordinated dive.
She can reveal with Multishot, but stealth plus burst heroes still reach her faster than she can respond.
Long range heroes force her to take fights on their terms; she relies on Hatred uptime that kiting prevents.

wants_from_team: A large tank to absorb attention
Shields or peel because she has low health
Allied CC to land Strafe and Hungering Arrow
A healer that keeps her topped up
gives_team: High single target damage that kills tanks
On demand area damage with Multishot
A stun with Rain of Vengeance
weaknesses: Needs positioning and uptime on basic attacks
evidence: Hungering Arrow, Multishot, Vault, Strafe, Rain of Vengeance, Hatred text
Manticore, Farflight Quiver, Frost Shot, Death Siphon talent text
Icy Veins role: extremely strong against healer heavy metas
Measured NGS block: 3006 hero damage per minute, win rate 0.496, 5.0 camps per game

lens_notes.damage_timing: Hatred stacks to ten and falls off after 5 seconds, so her damage climbs through a fight; the Burst Build with Hungering Arrow is the alternative.
lens_notes.damage_reach: Base range is standard; Farflight Quiver at 20 makes it long, and Multishot reaches far.
lens_notes.durability_source: Tempered by Discipline, Siphoning Arrows and Gloom heal her, but she has low base health.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: She wins by pressure on one target from her own range, not by diving or a single burst; Hungering Arrow plus Vault is the burst option.
lens_notes.escape: Vault is one dash and Hatred move speed helps, so she can leave but not through CC.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Frost Shot slows and Rain of Vengeance stuns for 0.5 seconds are talent and heroic choices; measured enemy CC time is 5.2 seconds so Rain is common.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Nothing removes CC; Gloom is spell armor and Vault cannot be used while stunned.
lens_notes.camp_play: Camp clear rating is 5 and measured camps are 5.0 a game, the top of this group.
lens_notes.vision_stealth: Multishot reveals and dismounts stealthed heroes, per Icy Veins.
lens_notes.power_curve: Icy Veins says she is strong in all phases; the earlier profile spike was mid because Strafe and Manticore arrive then.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Strafe is the usual heroic; Rain of Vengeance is a defensive stun instead.

lens_gaps: no vulnerable_to value for gap closers that pass Vault range (assassins such as Zeratul)
no lens for a sustain carry that is strong against healer heavy metas because stacking damage outpaces healing
